# Michael Korenevsky

> Senior Product Manager specializing in enterprise AI, predictive tooling, and high-stakes industrial software. Based in Europe. Open to senior PM and Head of Product roles.

Michael Korenevsky is a product leader with a track record of shipping AI-powered B2B products in manufacturing, additive manufacturing (3D printing), and industrial automation. He owns the full product lifecycle — from zero-to-one discovery through to instrumented production releases — and operates a personal AI workflow stack for requirements, research, and competitive intelligence.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://themishka.me): Full case studies, career timeline, and interactive prototypes
- [AMVero Fleet Intelligence](https://themishka.me/#selected-work): AI-powered fleet management system with predictive maintenance, live telemetry, and ROI simulation. Built for enterprise industrial clients.
- [Knauf Simulation](https://themishka.me/#selected-work): Assembly validation tool reducing first-time-right failures in physical manufacturing environments.

## Background

- Senior PM at Oqton (now part of 3D Systems) — led AI and data products for industrial manufacturing customers
- Previously: product roles at enterprise software companies across ERP integration, data pipelines, and workflow automation
- Domain depth: additive manufacturing, industrial IoT, predictive analytics, B2B SaaS

## How I Work

Michael uses a personal AI operations stack: Claude Code for spec refinement and backlog analysis, Figma for wireframes, and a market intelligence layer for competitive and customer research. He treats AI as a force-multiplier on PM throughput, not a replacement for judgment.
